svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Class Diagram - ИС Кафедры" id="departments_class_diagram"> <mxGraphModel dx="2150" dy="1098" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="1200" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam monochrome false
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #2C3E50
 ArrowColor #2980B9
}

enum AcademicDegree {
 NONE
 CANDIDATE_OF_SCIENCES
 DOCTOR_OF_SCIENCES
 PHD
}

enum AcademicTitle {
 NONE
 DOCENT
 PROFESSOR
}

enum Position {
 ASSISTANT
 SENIOR_LECTURER
 DOCENT
 PROFESSOR
 DEPARTMENT_HEAD
}

enum Gender {
 MALE
 FEMALE
}

enum ReportingForm {
 EXAM ' Экзамен: 0.5 ч * студ + 2 ч предэкз. консультация
 PASS_TEST ' Зачёт: 0.25 ч * студ
}

class Faculty {
 - name: String
 - deanFullName: String
 - phone: String
 - deanOfficeRoom: String
 - studentCount: Integer
 - foundationDate: Date
 + addDepartment(dept: Department): void
 + removeDepartment(dept: Department): void
 + getDepartments(): List<Department>
 + calculateTotalTeachers(): Integer
 + validateStaffToStudentRatio(): Boolean
}

class Department {
 - name: String
 - headFullName: String
 - phone: String
 - roomNumber: String
 - teacherCount: Integer
 - isGraduating: Boolean
 - foundationDate: Date
 + addTeacher(teacher: Teacher): void
 + removeTeacher(teacher: Teacher): void
 + getTeachers(): List<Teacher>
 + addCourse(course: Course): void
 + getCourses(): List<Course>
 + getTeacherCount(): Integer
 + assignCourseToTeacher(course: Course, teacher: Teacher): void
 + calculateTotalLoadHours(): Integer
}

class Teacher {
 - lastName: String
 - firstName: String
 - middleName: String
 - academicDegree: AcademicDegree
 - academicTitle: AcademicTitle
 - position: Position
 - gender: Gender
 - birthDate: Date
 - courseCount: Integer
 + getFullName(): String
 + assignCourse(course: Course): void
 + removeCourse(course: Course): void
 + getCourses(): List<Course>
 + getCourseCount(): Integer
 + calculateTotalLoad(): Integer
}

class Course {
 - title: String
 - specialty: String
 - studyYear: Integer
 - semester: Integer
 - studentCount: Integer
 + getAuditoryHours(): AuditoryHours
 + getAssessmentPlan(): AssessmentPlan
 + getSchedule(): CourseSchedule
 + addTopic(topic: Topic): void
 + removeTopic(topic: Topic): void
 + getTopics(): List<Topic>
 + calculateTotalHours(): Integer
 + validateSelfStudyLimits(): Boolean
}

class AuditoryHours {
 - lectureHours: Integer
 - practiceHours: Integer
 - labHours: Integer
 + getLectureHours(): Integer
 + getPracticeHours(): Integer
 + getLabHours(): Integer
 + getTotalAuditoryHours(): Integer
}

class AssessmentPlan {
 - reportingForm: ReportingForm
 - controlWorkCount: Integer
 + getReportingForm(): ReportingForm
 + getControlWorkCount(): Integer
 + calculateEvaluationHours(studentCount: Integer): Double
 + calculateExamConsultationHours(): Double
 + calculateTestGradingHours(studentCount: Integer): Double
}

class CourseSchedule {
 - startDate: Date
 - endDate: Date
 + getStartDate(): Date
 + getEndDate(): Date
 + calculateWeeks(): Integer
 + calculateWeeklyPairs(hours: Integer): Double
}

class AcademicLoad <<utility>> {
 + {static} calculateConsultationHours(lectureHours: Integer): Double
 + {static} calculateTotalHours(auditory: AuditoryHours, assessment: AssessmentPlan, studentCount: Integer): Integer
}

class Topic {
 - title: String
 - lectureHours: Integer
 - practiceHours: Integer
 - labHours: Integer
 - isMandatory: Boolean
 + getTotalHours(): Integer
 + canBeSelfStudy(): Boolean
 + setMandatory(mandatory: Boolean): void
}

' Отношения между сущностями
Faculty \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" Department : contains >
Department \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" Teacher : employs >
Department \"1\" o-- \"*\" Course : oversees >
Teacher \"1\" o-- \"*\" Course : conducts >

' Декомпозиция перегруженного класса Course
Course \"1\" *-- \"1\" AuditoryHours : contains >
Course \"1\" *-- \"1\" AssessmentPlan : specifies >
Course \"1\" *-- \"1\" CourseSchedule : follows >
Course \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" Topic : consists of >
Course ..> AcademicLoad : calculates via >

' Зависимости перечислений
Teacher ..> AcademicDegree : uses
Teacher ..> AcademicTitle : uses
Teacher ..> Position : uses
Teacher ..> Gender : uses
AssessmentPlan ..> ReportingForm : defines

note right of Faculty
 <b>Бизнес-правило 1:</b>
 calculateTotalTeachers() <= floor(studentCount / 10)
end note

note bottom of AssessmentPlan
 <b>Форма отчётности:</b>
 Взаимоисключающие формы:
 • EXAM: 0.5 * студ + 2 ч предэкз. конс.
 • PASS_TEST: 0.25 * студ
 КР: 0.15 * студ * controlWorkCount
end note

note bottom of AcademicLoad
 <b>Формула нагрузки курса:</b>
 TotalHours = ceil(
 Lec + Prac + Lab
 + 0.05 * Lec
 + (isExam ? 2.0 : 0)
 + (isExam ? 0.5 * students : 0.25 * students)
 + 0.15 * students * tests
 )
end note

note right of Topic
 <b>Бизнес-правило 2:</b>
 Для тем на СРС (isMandatory = false):
 hoursSelfStudy(k) <= 0.15 * Course.hours(k)
end note

Форма отчётности:
Взаимоисключающие формы:
• EXAM: 0.5 * студ + 2 ч предэкз. конс.
• PASS_TEST: 0.25 * студ
КР: 0.15 * студ * controlWorkCount

div.div:
Формула нагрузки курса:
TotalHours = ceil(
Lec + Prac + Lab
+ 0.05 * Lec
+ (isExam ? 2.0 : 0)
+ (isExam ? 0.5 * stud : 0.25 * stud)
+ 0.15 * stud * tests
)
